items.t: Said she and her legislative colleagues would act soon for more gun control after the attack at Michigan State University.
items.q: Michigan Senate Majority Leader Winnie Brinks (D) made clear she and her legislative colleagues will be acting “soon” for more gun control in the wake of the attack at Michigan State University.

record.t: Became the first woman to serve as majority leader of the Michigan Senate (2023).
record.q: Senator Winnie Brinks, who in 2023, became the first woman to serve as the majority leader in the Michigan Senate.

record.t: Was authorized by the Senate in a resolution to sue House Speaker Matt Hall over nine bills passed last session that were not sent to the governor.
record.q: Democratic state Senate Majority Leader Winnie Brinks was authorized by the Senate in a resolution to sue Republican House Speaker Matt Hall after he refused to send nine bills passed last session to Gov. Gretchen Whitmer’s (D-MI) desk.

record.t: Joined Gov. Gretchen Whitmer and House Speaker Matt Hall in a joint statement saying the legislature would pass a full budget "this week."
record.q: A joint statement by Democratic Gov. Gretchen Whitmer, state Senate Majority Leader Winnie Brinks, a Democrat, and state Speaker Matt Hall, a Republican, said the legislature will pass a full budget “this week.”
